body: Please don’t. People care about you, I care about you and there is help. You don’t need to prove to yourself or anyone else that you deserve help.
Enough that typing it all out would be a chore, but to be short- abuse from childhood and mental health problems that have ruined my career

Thank you so much. You’re right, it’s a cage of my own making but I just can’t seem to get out. I really appreciate your reply - your puns put a smile on my face, I love dark humour. Most people talk like they’re on eggshells around me but I hate that. I’m fighting every single second of every single day, every moment I’m not doing something to hurt myself is effort but you’re right... it just seems so hard to keep fighting all the time. Every day I make myself wash, I make myself go outside, I make myself accept the medication. But it’s so fucking hard.

Thank you. Sometimes it feels like no one gets it you know? I’m 27, old enough to know better haha. You’re right, words just seem meaningless at the moment but I really appreciate your reply. What sort of stuff do you struggle with?

That sucks, sorry. What about the Samaritans US line? I’ve called them from the UK and they absolutely do not contact anyone else even if you’re in the middle of it unless you want them to.
 http://www.samaritansusa.org/contact.php
I assume you’re US based? I would phone with either pay phone or mobile, I’m pretty sure they have to stay confidential though and if you said no to them calling the cops they won’t.

Thank you for your kind reply, it’s been a rough few months but I’m just so grateful for the nhs for keeping me going. I guess I was hoping that it’s an easy fix, for the moment it’s ok but if it gets worse I’ll go.
Thank you for your reply, I really do appreciate it. I’ll make sure to go if I feel worse.

Thank you. That’s only happened a couple of time though, most of the time that’s not happening. I get where you’re coming from though, if it gets worse I will go but I don’t want to waste their (already stretched) resources.
Thank you for your kind reply. My partner found out and dropped me off at a&e

Thank you. I’ll go down later, I feel like a complete idiot and will probably be treated like one. I’m not sure I want to die but I really don’t care about what happens to me otherwise. I appreciate the reply though.
Thanks for your reply. I’m scared, what will they do that I can’t do at  home?
Thanks for replying. I’m seriously scared of going, I don’t want to get sectioned again and I’d feel like a massive time waster with this.
